senses.en: behaviour or thinking that differs from what is usual or accepted

example.en: Her nonconformity made her stand out at the office.
example.zh: 她的不墨守成规让她在公司里很显眼。

senses.en: failure to agree or match with something

example.en: The auditors found a nonconformity in the safety records.
example.zh: 审计人员在安全记录中发现一处不符合项。

senses.en: showing shame or embarrassment; sheepish

example.en: He gave a shamefaced smile when caught making a mistake.
example.zh: 被发现犯了错时，他不好意思地笑了笑。

senses.en: the excessive expression of tender or sad feelings

example.en: Critics said the novel was weakened by its sentimentalism.
example.zh: 评论家认为这部小说因感伤主义而失色。

senses.en: the process of breaking a substance into very fine particles or a fine spray

example.en: Atomization of the fuel improves engine efficiency.
example.zh: 燃料的雾化可提高发动机效率。

senses.en: the act of dividing something into small, isolated units

example.en: Critics blame social media for the atomization of society.
example.zh: 批评者指责社交媒体导致了社会的原子化。

senses.en: to organize something into a systematic scheme or simplified diagram

example.en: The researcher schematized the data into a simple chart.
example.zh: 研究者将数据整理成一张简明的图表。

senses.en: a general rule, principle, or standard in art or literature

example.en: Her novel broke the accepted canons of fiction.
example.zh: 她的小说打破了公认的小说创作规范。

senses.en: the officially recognized list of works or stories considered genuine, especially in fiction or religion

example.en: That character is not part of the official canon.
example.zh: 那个角色不属于官方正典。

senses.en: a priest who is a member of a cathedral

example.en: He was appointed canon of the cathedral.
example.zh: 他被任命为该座堂的法政牧师。

senses.en: the back of a horse; (on horseback) riding on a horse

example.en: She spent the summer riding on horseback.
example.zh: 她夏天都在骑马。

senses.en: a member of a senate, especially a national or state legislature
senses.zh: 参议员；（某些国家的）上议院议员

example.en: The senator spoke about the new education bill.
example.zh: 这位参议员谈到了新的教育法案。

senses.en: in a way that relates to the body

example.en: Regular exercise keeps you physically healthy.
example.zh: 经常锻炼能使你身体健康。

senses.en: in a way that relates to real physical space or things rather than ideas or feelings
senses.zh: 在实际空间中；在物理层面

example.en: The two offices are physically separate but share the same computer network.
example.zh: 这两个办公室在空间上是分开的，但共用同一个计算机网络。

senses.en: in accordance with the laws of physics; in a way that is possible in the physical world

example.en: It is physically impossible for a person to lift that heavy machine alone.
example.zh: 一个人独自抬起那台重型机器在物理上是不可能的。

senses.en: A shop that sells food and other household goods.

example.en: There is a small grocery on the corner.
example.zh: 街角有一家小食品杂货店。

senses.en: Food and household goods bought from a shop; usually used in the plural.

example.en: We need to buy groceries for the week.
example.zh: 我们需要买一周的食品杂货。

senses.en: to put a new or working thing in place of one that is old, broken, or no longer used

example.en: The mechanic replaced the broken part.
example.zh: 机械师更换了损坏的零件。

senses.en: to take the position or role of someone or something

example.en: She replaced him as team leader.
example.zh: 她接替他成为团队负责人。

senses.en: the process of building something such as a house, road, or bridge

example.en: The construction of the new school will begin next month.
example.zh: 新学校的建设将于下个月开始。

senses.en: a building or other structure that has been built

example.en: The museum is an impressive concrete construction.
example.zh: 这座博物馆是一座令人印象深刻的混凝土建筑。

senses.en: the grammatical arrangement of words, or a group of words that functions as a unit

example.en: The passive construction is common in formal writing.
example.zh: 被动结构在正式写作中很常见。

senses.en: to cut wool or hair off with scissors or a machine

example.en: Farmers shear the sheep in spring.
example.zh: 农民在春天给羊剪毛。

senses.en: to break off or be cut off suddenly

example.en: The bolt sheared off under the strain.
example.zh: 螺栓在应力下折断了。

senses.en: a force or strain that makes parts of an object slide in opposite directions parallel to each other

example.en: The metal failed under shear stress.
example.zh: 金属在剪应力下失效了。

senses.en: to spread out or scatter in all directions

example.en: The news diffused quickly through social media.
example.zh: 消息很快通过社交媒体传播开来。

senses.en: spread out over a wide area; not concentrated

example.en: The room was lit by soft, diffuse light from the window.
example.zh: 房间里洒满了窗户透进来的柔和漫射光。

senses.en: a group of states or countries linked for shared political or economic purposes

example.en: The Commonwealth of Nations includes many former British territories.
example.zh: 英联邦包括许多前英国领土。

senses.en: the official title of certain US states and territories, such as Massachusetts and Puerto Rico
senses.zh: （美国某些州和自治领的正式名称）州；自治邦

example.en: Massachusetts is officially called a commonwealth.
example.zh: 马萨诸塞州在官方名称上被称为 commonwealth。

senses.en: an independent state or political community, especially a republic

example.en: The old republic was once described as a commonwealth of free citizens.
example.zh: 这个古老的共和国曾被描述为自由公民的共同体。

senses.en: the activity or sport of moving through water

example.en: Swimming is a great way to stay fit.
example.zh: 游泳是保持健康的好方法。

senses.en: a woman with light yellow hair

example.en: A blonde was waiting at the entrance.
example.zh: 一位金发女郎在入口处等候。

senses.en: having light yellow hair; pale in color

example.en: She has blonde hair and blue eyes.
example.zh: 她有一头金发和一双蓝眼睛。

senses.en: the tenth month of the year, between September and November

example.en: We usually take a vacation in October.
example.zh: 我们通常在十月休假。

senses.en: the first month of the year

example.en: We usually take a short trip in January.
example.zh: 我们通常在一月份进行一次短途旅行。

senses.en: an animal with feathers and wings that lays eggs

example.en: A small bird was singing outside my window.
example.zh: 一只小鸟在我窗外唱歌。

senses.en: the meat of a bird such as chicken or turkey, eaten as food

example.en: We roasted a large bird for dinner.
example.zh: 我们烤了一只大禽鸟作为晚餐。

senses.en: to watch and study birds in their natural habitat

example.en: They spent the weekend birding in the wetlands.
example.zh: 他们周末在湿地观鸟。

senses.en: a person who survives a dangerous or difficult event

example.en: The survivors of the earthquake were rescued within hours.
example.zh: 地震的幸存者在数小时内获救。

senses.en: a person who continues to live after others have died

example.en: She is the only survivor of her generation in the family.
example.zh: 她是家族中同辈里唯一健在的人。

senses.en: money or property left to someone in a will

example.en: She made a generous bequest to the hospital in her will.
example.zh: 她在遗嘱中向医院留下一笔慷慨的遗赠。

senses.en: very serious or severe, often causing harm or suffering

example.en: He was charged with grievous bodily harm.
example.zh: 他被控造成严重身体伤害。

senses.en: causing great sorrow or grief

example.en: The news of her death was a grievous loss to the community.
example.zh: 她去世的消息令社区悲痛不已。

senses.en: an electronic component that allows current to flow in one direction only

example.en: The circuit uses a diode to protect against reverse current.
example.zh: 该电路使用二极管来防止反向电流。

senses.en: easily influenced by others or by new ideas
senses.zh: 易受影响的；可塑性强的

example.en: Young children are highly impressionable.
example.zh: 幼儿极易受影响。

senses.en: to give someone energy or strength; to make something stronger or livelier

example.en: The cool morning air invigorated the hikers.
example.zh: 清晨凉爽的空气使徒步者们精神振奋。

senses.en: to write something down quickly and briefly

example.en: She jotted down the phone number on a napkin.
example.zh: 她在餐巾纸上匆匆记下了电话号码。

senses.en: a very small amount

example.en: There is not a jot of evidence to support that claim.
example.zh: 没有任何证据支持那个说法。

senses.en: free from worries or responsibilities

example.en: She spent a carefree summer at the beach.
example.zh: 她在海边度过了无忧无虑的夏天。

senses.en: a small tower on a building

example.en: The castle has four turrets at its corners.
example.zh: 这座城堡的四角各有一座塔楼。

senses.en: a rotating structure holding guns on a tank, ship, or aircraft

example.en: The tank's turret turned toward the enemy line.
example.zh: 坦克的炮塔转向敌方阵线。

senses.en: (literary) to happen to someone, especially something bad

example.en: Disaster befell the village on the night of the flood.
example.zh: 洪水之夜，灾难降临到这个村庄。

senses.en: (literary) to happen or occur

example.en: They waited to see what would befall.
example.zh: 他们等着看会发生什么。

senses.en: to move on foot at a regular pace

example.en: We walk to school every morning.
example.zh: 我们每天早上步行去学校。

senses.en: a trip or outing on foot, often for pleasure or exercise

example.en: Let's take a short walk after lunch.
example.zh: 午饭后我们去散会儿步吧。

senses.en: to go with someone on foot to guide or accompany them

example.en: I'll walk you home after the meeting.
example.zh: 会议结束后我陪你走回家。

senses.en: a unit of length equal to three feet or about 0.91 metres
senses.zh: 码（长度单位，等于3英尺或约0.91米）

example.en: The pool is twenty-five yards long.
example.zh: 这个游泳池长25码。

senses.en: an enclosed area next to a building, often with grass or paving

example.en: The children played in the back yard.
example.zh: 孩子们在后院玩耍。

senses.en: an outdoor area used for a particular work or storage purpose
senses.zh: （用于特定工作或存放的）场地，厂区

example.en: The train waited outside the railway yard.
example.zh: 火车在铁路调车场外等候。

senses.en: the father of a person's mother or father

example.en: My grandfather taught me how to fish.
example.zh: 我的祖父教过我钓鱼。

senses.en: to exempt someone or something from a new rule because of an earlier status
senses.zh: 使（因原有身份或状况）不受新规定限制

example.en: The company grandfathered existing customers into the old pricing plan.
example.zh: 公司让现有客户继续按旧价格方案执行。

senses.en: the head of state of a republic, usually elected
senses.zh: 总统；国家主席（通常经选举产生）

example.en: The president addressed the nation on television.
example.zh: 总统通过电视向全国发表讲话。

senses.en: the person who leads a company, organization, or club

example.en: She became president of the local chess club.
example.zh: 她成了当地国际象棋俱乐部的主席。

senses.en: an item of clothing, such as a shirt or dress

example.en: She carefully folded each garment before packing it.
example.zh: 她把每件衣服都仔细叠好再打包。

senses.en: to make something seem bigger, better, or worse than it really is

example.en: Don't exaggerate the problem; it's not that serious.
example.zh: 别夸大这个问题，没那么严重。

senses.en: in a careful, organized, and methodical way

example.en: She systematically checked every file before submitting the report.
example.zh: 她在提交报告前有条理地检查了每一份文件。

senses.en: to get involved in someone else's affairs without being asked

example.en: Don't interfere in other people's business.
example.zh: 不要干涉别人的事务。

senses.en: to prevent something from working or happening properly

example.en: Noise can interfere with your sleep.
example.zh: 噪音会妨碍你的睡眠。

senses.en: covering or involving the whole world

example.en: The company has a worldwide reputation for quality.
example.zh: 这家公司以质量在全世界享有盛誉。

senses.en: in or to all parts of the world

example.en: The song became popular worldwide.
example.zh: 这首歌在全球流行开来。

senses.en: to completely cover or swallow something

example.en: Flames quickly engulfed the old wooden house.
example.zh: 火焰很快吞没了那座老木屋。

senses.en: to affect someone strongly or completely

example.en: She was engulfed by a feeling of despair.
example.zh: 她被绝望的情绪所笼罩。

senses.en: hunting and eating other animals

example.en: Owls are predatory birds that hunt at night.
example.zh: 猫头鹰是夜间捕猎的猛禽。

senses.en: seeking to exploit or harm others for gain

example.en: The company was accused of predatory pricing to drive out competitors.
example.zh: 该公司被指控用掠夺性定价排挤竞争对手。

senses.en: feeling or showing regret or sorrow, often with a slight smile

example.en: He gave a rueful smile when he realized he had locked his keys inside.
example.zh: 当他意识到自己把钥匙锁在里面时，他无奈地笑了笑。

senses.en: a garden plant with large brightly colored flowers, especially cultivated in autumn

example.en: The garden is full of yellow chrysanthemums in autumn.
example.zh: 秋天花园里开满了黄色的菊花。

senses.en: a lottery in which people buy tickets for a chance to win a prize

example.en: She won a gift basket in the school raffle.
example.zh: 她在学校抽奖中赢了一个礼品篮。

senses.en: to offer something as a prize in a raffle
senses.zh: 以抽彩方式出售（或赠送）

example.en: They raffled off a car to raise money for charity.
example.zh: 他们以抽奖方式送出一辆汽车为慈善筹款。

senses.en: a priest or clergyman in charge of a church or parish, especially in the Church of England
senses.zh: 教区牧师；教区代理牧师

example.en: The vicar welcomed everyone to the Sunday service.
example.zh: 牧师欢迎大家参加主日礼拜。

senses.en: very foolish or crazy behavior

example.en: Driving through the blizzard at night was pure lunacy.
example.zh: 夜里开车穿越暴风雪简直是疯了。

senses.en: (old-fashioned or legal) mental illness; insanity

example.en: In older legal texts, lunacy referred to severe mental disorder.
example.zh: 在旧法律文本中，lunacy 指严重的精神失常。

senses.en: to move more slowly or make something move more slowly

example.en: The train began to decelerate as it approached the city.
example.zh: 火车接近城市时开始减速。

senses.en: peace and agreement between people or groups

example.en: The two communities have lived in concord for decades.
example.zh: 这两个社区和睦共处了几十年。

senses.en: a formal agreement between states or parties

example.en: The two nations signed a concord on border trade.
example.zh: 两国签署了一项边境贸易协定。

senses.en: full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness
senses.zh: 热情洋溢的，兴高采烈的

example.en: The crowd gave the team an exuberant welcome.
example.zh: 人群热情洋溢地欢迎这支队伍。

senses.en: growing strongly and abundantly

example.en: Exuberant vegetation covered the abandoned field.
example.zh: 茂盛的植被覆盖了这块荒地。

senses.en: the watery fluid that circulates inside a plant

example.en: Sap rose in the trees as spring arrived.
example.zh: 春天来临，树里的汁液开始上升。

senses.en: to gradually weaken someone's strength or confidence

example.en: The long illness sapped his strength.
example.zh: 长期的疾病耗尽了他的体力。

senses.en: to do better than someone else

example.en: She always tries to outdo her brother at school.
example.zh: 她总是在学习上努力超过她的哥哥。

senses.en: by a thousand times as much

example.en: The company's value increased thousand-fold in a decade.
example.zh: 公司的价值十年间增长了千倍。

senses.en: a thousand times as great

example.en: They hoped for a thousand-fold increase in sales.
example.zh: 他们希望销售额有千倍的增长。
